plugin_saml.title: SAML single sign-on
plugin_saml.description: Enterprise IdP sign-in (SAML 2.0 SP): import IdP metadata or fetch it by URL, map attributes and groups; hand the ACS, SP metadata and certificate to the IdP.
plugin_saml.empty: No SAML identity source configured yet
plugin_saml.emptyHint: Ask your IdP administrator for the metadata to get started; no extra setup is needed on the sign-in page.

emptySteps.get: Ask your IdP administrator for the SAML metadata (XML file or metadata URL)
emptySteps.create: Create a SAML identity source: paste the XML, import a file, or fetch it by URL
emptySteps.enable: Save and enable it; the enterprise SSO entry appears on the sign-in page

plugin_saml.deleteConfirm: Delete identity source "{{name}}"? Bindings of users who signed in through it are kept.

hints.enabled: Only enabled sources appear on the sign-in page.
hints.idpMetadataUrl: After filling this in, use "Fetch from URL" to refresh the metadata; the self-test also checks that the remote copy still matches.
hints.idpMetadata: Paste the EntityDescriptor XML from the IdP; saving requires a parsable IDPSSODescriptor.
hints.attrUsername: Attribute used as the local username; leave empty to use the NameID.
hints.attrGroups: Attribute holding the user's groups (multi-valued); group mappings read from here.
hints.autoCreate: Create a local account (no password) on first sign-in, subject to the tenant user quota.
hints.matchExisting: Allow linking this identity to an existing same-name account that is not yet bound to SAML. Super admins and built-in role holders are never matched.
hints.defaultRole: Role code granted when a user is auto-created; matched group mappings take precedence.
hints.defaultRoleOff: Only applies when auto-create is on.
hints.groupRoleMappings: Enter the full group values exactly as returned by the IdP; matching is case- and whitespace-sensitive, DN parsing and nested groups are not performed. Roles are granted only when a user is auto-created by default; turn on "Sync roles on sign-in" to reconcile them on every sign-in.
hints.roleCodes: One role code per line (the code shown in role management).
hints.requireMappedGroup: When on, sign-in is refused if none of the assertion's groups match a mapping; at least one mapping is required.
hints.syncRolesOnLogin: Reconcile roles from the group mappings on every sign-in: roles no longer mapped are revoked, but only those recorded as granted by this source; other roles on the user (assigned by hand or by another identity source) are untouched. Nothing changes when the assertion carries no groups.
hints.allowIdpInitiated: Allow the IdP portal to start sign-in without an SP AuthnRequest. After success the user lands on the admin home; assertion replay protection needs a shared cache.
hints.signAuthnRequest: Sign the AuthnRequest with the SP private key (RSA-SHA256). Configure the SP certificate at the IdP first, or requests may be rejected.
hints.nameIdFormat: NameID format requested in the AuthnRequest; keep "unspecified" if unsure.
hints.forceAuthn: Ask the IdP to re-authenticate on every sign-in (ForceAuthn) instead of reusing its session; some IdPs must enable this first.
hints.requireSignedResponseForCBC: When on, an AES-CBC encrypted assertion is decrypted only after the IdP has signed the response, blocking XML Encryption padding/format oracles per SAML errata E93. Most IdPs sign only the assertion, so confirm the IdP signs the response before enabling, or sign-ins will be rejected.
hints.rejectUnknownConditions: Reject sign-in when the assertion's Conditions contain child elements this system does not understand (saml-core requires treating them as Indeterminate); enable only if the IdP sends no extension conditions.
hints.authnContext: Declare acceptable authentication contexts in the AuthnRequest (for example require MFA); with the enforcement switch below on, the assertion must match one of them.
hints.authnContextCustom: Comma-separated class URIs (urn: or http(s)://), matched exactly, at most 10.
hints.requireAuthnContext: The assertion's AuthnContextClassRef must match one of the selected classes, or sign-in is rejected.
hints.idpEntityId: When the metadata bundles several IdPs, pick the one this system should trust; a single entity is selected automatically.
hints.syncProfile: Bound accounts take nickname / email / phone from the assertion on every login; empty values never overwrite, and username, status and roles stay local.
hints.requireEncryptedAssertion: The IdP must encrypt assertions with the SP certificate; plaintext assertions are rejected. Make sure the IdP has encryption enabled first.
hints.signMetadata: Sign the SP metadata with the SP private key (RSA-SHA256); enable when the IdP verifies metadata signatures.
hints.allowSha1Signatures: SHA-1 signed assertions / responses / logout messages are rejected by default; enable only for legacy IdPs, and only for this source.
hints.spEntityIdOverride: Leave empty to use the SP metadata URL as the Entity ID. Some IdPs require a fixed value; it must be a URI with a scheme (https://… or urn:…).
hints.metadataCaCert: When IdP metadata is issued by an internal CA, paste its root/intermediate certificates; metadata fetches then trust only this CA.
hints.metadataSignCert: With a pinned certificate, saving, refreshing and self-test all require the metadata root element to carry a matching XML signature; leave empty to rely on TLS only.

cert.title: SP signing certificate
cert.rotateHint: Two-step rollover: publish the new certificate, update the IdP with it (or with the SP metadata), then switch. The old one stays for 7 days.
cert.published: New certificate published. Import it (or the SP metadata) at the IdP, then switch.
cert.promoteConfirm: Switch to the published certificate? Signing moves to the new one; the old certificate stays for decryption for 7 days.
cert.promoted: Switched to the new certificate; the old one remains for 7 days
cert.nextHint: Published but not used for signing yet. Update trust at the IdP first. Expires: {{date}}
cert.importHint: Paste a PEM SP certificate and private key (RSA ≥ 2048 or EC ≥ P-256). The current pair is replaced immediately and kept for 7 days for decryption; update the IdP with this certificate too.
cert.importConfirm: Importing replaces the SP certificate and key of "{{name}}" immediately and the IdP must be updated. Continue?
cert.imported: Certificate and key imported; update the SP certificate at the IdP
cert.prevHint: Previous certificate kept until {{date}}: decrypt-only, and listed in the metadata during that window.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters
errors.metadataRequired: Paste the IdP metadata or fetch it by URL first
errors.attrInvalid: Attribute names cannot contain spaces or control characters and must be at most 255 bytes
errors.defaultRole: Invalid role code (at most 64 bytes, not super)
errors.mappingGroup: Group value must not be empty and must be at most 2048 bytes
errors.mappingRole: One role code per line, no duplicates, not super
errors.mappingRequired: At least one mapping is required when a mapped group is mandatory
errors.entityInvalid: Invalid Entity ID (at most 500 bytes, no control characters)
errors.entityRequired: Choose the Entity ID to use
errors.authnContextRequired: Choose an authentication context class before enabling enforcement
errors.authnContextInvalid: Authentication context classes must be urn: or http(s):// URIs, comma-separated
errors.authnContextDuplicate: Authentication context classes must be unique
errors.fileTooLarge: Metadata file must be at most 1 MiB

refresh.unchanged: Metadata is already up to date

idp.selectRequired: The metadata bundles {{count}} IdPs; edit the source and choose the Entity ID to use.
